title: Norwegian Fish Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish featuring Norwegian fish paired with a sweet and tangy glaze, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Norwegian fish fillets
ingredients.notes: You can use other white fish fillets if Norwegian fish is not available.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger or use ginger paste.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use sea salt or kosher salt.

instructions: In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic.
Add the fish fillets to the bowl and coat with the glaze.
Thread the fish onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.
